response.overview: Tells the story of the ups and downs of four children who attend school together. They are Kobus, the soccer star; Noel, the student with a beautiful singing voice; Moe, the math whiz; and Jose, the boy obsessed with boxing. These four friends later befriend Christal, a transfer student from Jakarta who is skilled at playing the piano. The five of them work together to prevent their school from closing. The group of friends participates in various competitions to represent their school and save it from closure. They also celebrate their friendship at Bukit Bintang.
response.title: Lima Bintang Timur
